## Install

Download `NockSetup-.exe` from the latest release and run it. It installs just for you (no admin rights), adds Nock to the Start menu so you can find it by searching "Nock", and can start it with Windows. Uninstall it from Windows Settings → Apps like any other app.

Nock is not code-signed yet, so Windows may show a "Windows protected your PC" note (More info → Run anyway), and a PC with Smart App Control on may block it outright. See Smart App Control for the fix.

Prefer no installer? The same release also has `Nock-portable-.exe`: put it in a folder you will keep and run it. (Nock adds its own Start menu shortcut when it runs, so search finds it either way; tray → Show in Start menu and search turns that off.) [...] Notch at the top centre. Click it and a panel opens with tabs: Media, Controls, Today (focus timer, to-dos, calendar), Stats, Clipboard, Shelf (drop files on it), Apps, Games and Power.
 Top bar along the top of the screen: active app name, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, brightness, battery and clock, each with a dropdown (join Wi-Fi networks, connect Bluetooth devices, sliders, calendar). Optional clock styles and a CPU / memory read-out.
 A little life: a buddy character on the bar, scripted scenes, an arcade with four mouse-only games, and small reactions on the pill (squish on click, glow with the music, confetti when the timer ends). [...] Smart pill: the notch tells you things without a click. Amber "Battery low" with time left, "Mic on" with the time and a click-to-mute mic icon, "Link / Path / Colour / Code copied" (click a link or path to open it), a break nudge after 90 minutes of steady use, and meeting countdowns from your calendar. Tray → Smart hints turns it off. See Smart pill.
 Idle notch extras (all optional): a small glance next to the clock (tasks left, focus minutes today, CPU and RAM, or your next meeting), a thin focus progress line while a timer runs, a workday progress line, and scroll-up paging. Only the focus line is on by default, and it only shows while a focus session runs. See Idle notch.
 Gentle reminders (all off by default): drink water, and look away from the screen (20-20-20).
